title: Jeff NDE 4330
content: I was in the school parking lot, having a cigarette. My friends were going somewhere in the car, so I sat on the hood of the car. My friend revved the car forward, which sent my body flying off the hood of the car onto the ground. I landed on my feet; but unfortunately, the G-force of the car's speed made me fall on my back very hard and very fast. I then hit my head on the ground. Upon impact, my vision went black. Through the seconds of my darkened vision, I saw what seemed like multiple bright lights surround my body's shape. The colors were very bright, yellowish-white color mixed with a neon blue. Seconds later I regained consciousness and was in shock lying on the ground.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident. Direct head injury Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) I was car surfing and was flung off the hood of the car. I hit the ground very hard.

elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Less consciousness and alertness than normal As above.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Lying on my back right after the impact and the lights ceased.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I lost all sense of time dates, names. I was in a neutral part of my brain.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: Very colorful bright neon lights surrounding the shape of my body from my point of view.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I was in a zone where I heard no voices. Just my thoughts.

elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain The lights I saw could have been in the shape of my body, or a circular shape.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I have no clue.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I was scared, but when I saw the colorful lights I just was awestruck.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control Some thoughts in my head could have been so.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will

elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes For the past few years I have been sensing (hearing, smelling, waves in my energy field) strong energies surrounding me. Physic abilities. And newly gained knowledge of understanding of the world.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: What was meaningful to me was the colors I saw. Truly the most vibrant and emotional colors my eyes have ever seen.
